cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace'); import ref as refmod
def run(req):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/submission/cli.py'],
                       input=json.dumps(req).encode(), capture_output=True, cwd='/workspace')
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr.decode()[-600:]
    return json.loads(p.stdout.decode())

# lag: FIFO residents with lower rank than the served PIFO head are overtaken
req = {"runs":[dict(banks=1, load_balancers=1, fifo_bytes=100, pifo_bytes=100,
    refill_batch=1, sample_period=100, borders=[0,100], policy={"kind":"sff"},
    events=[["enqueue",1,1,1,5],["enqueue",2,1,1,10],["enqueue",3,1,1,3],
            ["dequeue",1],["dequeue",1],["dequeue",1],["inspect",3]])]}
got = run(req)
exp_log = [
  [0,"enqueue",1,5,0,0,0,True],
  [1,"enqueue",2,10,0,0,0,True],
  [2,"enqueue",3,3,0,0,0,True],
  [3,"dequeue",0,0,1,5,1,0,[]],
  [4,"dequeue",1,0,2,10,1,0,[]],
  [5,"dequeue",2,0,3,3,0,2,[]],
  [6,"inspect",3,None],
]
log = got['runs'][0]['log']
print("lag/pushout log ok:", log == exp_log)
for a,b in zip(log,exp_log):
    if a != b: print("   got",a,"exp",b)
print("reference agrees:", refmod.run_request(req) == got)

# cross-bank overtaking: bank1 serves a high rank while bank0 holds lower ranks
req2 = {"runs":[dict(banks=2, load_balancers=1, fifo_bytes=100, pifo_bytes=100,
    refill_batch=4, sample_period=100, borders=[0,100], policy={"kind":"sff"},
    events=[["enqueue",1,1,1,50],["enqueue",2,1,1,1],["enqueue",3,1,1,2],
            ["enqueue",4,1,1,60],["dequeue",6],["inspect",2],["inspect",3]])]}
got2 = run(req2)
print("cross-bank log:")
for row in got2['runs'][0]['log']: print("  ", row)
print("reference agrees:", refmod.run_request(req2) == got2)
EOF
